owner: store (router-private; a derived projection of the event log, machine-local, never published to a shared repo)
rationale: ONE store schema for learned intent — NOT a separate phrasebook-vs-store pair (LOCKED decision: avoids a C0->C1 migration). A single `source` field (seed|manual|feedback) partitions provenance: C0 activates entries with source in {seed, manual}; C1 flips `feedback` active. Because all three source values and every weighting/outcome field are frozen in v1 NOW, no schema change is needed to move from reviewable (C0) to automatic (C1) calibration. Frozen alongside intent-feedback so the derived projection and its truth log agree from the first write. Additive OPTIONAL keys allowed within v1.

C1.note: Recency exponential-decay half-life for deterministic weighting. Additive OPTIONAL key; absent = no decay (C0 behavior).
intent_key of the entry that supersedes this one on an intent_key conflict (corrections supersede). Additive OPTIONAL key.
Timestamp of the last automatic calibration pass that touched this entry. Additive OPTIONAL key.

R-resilience.note: Drift-detection hash of the normalized entry, used to detect corruption and trigger self-repair. Additive OPTIONAL key.

additive_note: C0 uses {intent_key, utterance_examples, target_verb, param_bindings, source, version} with source in {seed, manual}; weight/confidence/hit_count/last_used/outcome_stats are present in v1 for C1 to populate WITHOUT a schema change. The `source` enum already carries `feedback`, so enabling automatic calibration (C1) is an activation, not a migration. All deferred_additions are OPTIONAL keys; the source enum only ever EXTENDS.
